purpose: Expand the documentary record while preserving the distinction between primary records, government findings, judicial holdings, allegations, testimony, later developments and unresolved questions.

population_priorities.title: Evidence Ledger expansion
population_priorities.target: Add additional official and primary-source records with stable identifiers, provenance, what each record establishes, and explicit limitations.

population_priorities.title: Chronology expansion
population_priorities.target: Add sourced event entries only where timestamps and institutional context can be supported by identified records.

population_priorities.title: Security and response expansion
population_priorities.target: Separate warning, intelligence processing, request, authorization, mobilization, deployment and operational response.

population_priorities.title: Legal record expansion
population_priorities.target: Track charges, pleas, verdicts, dismissals, appellate rulings, Supreme Court decisions and clemency without collapsing distinct procedural stages.

population_priorities.title: Voices and testimony expansion
population_priorities.target: Catalog sworn testimony, direct observation, interviews, contemporaneous communications and conflicting accounts with corroboration notes.

admission_standard: Identify the originator and date of the source.
State what the source establishes and what it does not establish.
Do not convert allegations into facts by repetition.
Do not treat congressional findings as judicial findings.
Do not treat charges as convictions.
Preserve later developments without silently rewriting earlier procedural history.
Cross-references indicate relevance; they do not by themselves establish causation, motive, guilt, innocence or legal responsibility.
